patch_description: Replace part of the purely Gaussian initial population with geometrically diverse, unrestricted seeds.  The 14-point diameter packing has many narrow basins with distinct contact graphs, so random starts alone can repeatedly converge to similar local optima.  In particular, staggered two-ring configurations give good spherical-code-like contact patterns, while icosahedral 12-point cores plus two independently placed extra points provide a high-quality but non-antipodally-constrained starting topology.  Small perturbations retain diversity without imposing symmetry on the final result.  The total population size remains exactly 36 and all candidates still pass through the existing normalization and optimization pipeline.
